title: If You Build It, They Will Come
summary: A thoughtful blog post debunking the popular startup myth 'If you build it, they will come,' explaining why great product quality alone is insufficient for business success without deliberate distribution, marketing, and go-to-market strategies.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that building an excellent product will automatically attract users and customers.
why_valuable: Provides realistic guidance for founders and product builders on the importance of distribution strategy alongside product development.
